title: Complex covariance
statement: Given a complex Fourier system on finite sets $\Omega$ and $\iota$, and functions $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$, define their covariance as $\sum_{x\in\Omega}\mu(x)\overline{(f(x)-\mathbb{E}_{\mu}f)}(g(x)-\mathbb{E}_{\mu}g)$, where $\mu$ is the system's probability law and $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}$ denotes expectation under that law.
hypotheses_covered: A complex Fourier system on $\Omega$ and $\iota$
